# SkillsUniversity.org

> SkillsUniversity.org is an online training academy founded in 2021, teaching practical, no-code AI skills. It offers two courses: "AI Tools for Entrepreneurs", a 75-minute masterclass covering 20+ AI tools across 5 modules (marketing, sales, content, advertising, CRM) for business owners; and "AI Fundamentals for Kids", a self-paced course for children aged 10-16 covering how AI works, prompting, learning honestly with AI, creating with AI, building a first no-code project, and online safety. Both courses include lifetime access and a 7-day money-back guarantee. Over 3,000 entrepreneurs and 100+ businesses have trained with SkillsUniversity.

## Courses

- [Home — SkillsUniversity.org](https://skillsuniversity.org/): About the academy and an overview of both courses.
- [AI Tools for Entrepreneurs — 75-Minute Masterclass](https://skillsuniversity.org/ai-tools-for-entrepreneurs/): For founders and small business owners. Curriculum, pricing and enrolment. Regional pricing for the USA, UK, Europe and India.
- [AI Fundamentals for Kids — Ages 10-16](https://skillsuniversity.org/ai-fundamentals-for-kids/): A self-paced course for children. Six modules covering how AI works, prompting, using AI honestly for schoolwork, creating with AI, building a first project, and online safety. No coding required; purchased and supervised by a parent.

## Blog

- [Blog index](https://skillsuniversity.org/blog/): Practical, no-fluff articles on using AI in business.
- [How Entrepreneurs Are Using AI to Close More Deals](https://skillsuniversity.org/blog/ai-in-sales.html): AI for prospecting, personalized outreach, follow-ups, and forecasting.
- [How Small Businesses Are Using AI to Market Smarter](https://skillsuniversity.org/blog/ai-in-marketing.html): AI for content creation, ad testing, and email personalization.
- [AI for Startups: Doing More With a Smaller Team](https://skillsuniversity.org/blog/ai-for-startups.html): How early-stage founders use AI for research, support, building, and hiring.
- [AI for Growing Businesses: Scaling Without Scaling Headcount](https://skillsuniversity.org/blog/ai-for-growing-businesses.html): Using AI to handle more volume in operations, support, and data.
- [Claude vs. Gemini for Business](https://skillsuniversity.org/blog/claude-and-gemini-for-business.html): Choosing between AI assistants for everyday business use.

- [Best AI Tools for WhatsApp Marketing for Small Businesses](https://skillsuniversity.org/blog/best-ai-tools-whatsapp-marketing-small-business.html): AI chat assistants, smart broadcasts, and follow-up automation on WhatsApp.
- [AI Lead Generation for Small Business: A Practical Guide](https://skillsuniversity.org/blog/ai-lead-generation-small-business.html): Finding, qualifying, contacting, and following up leads with AI.
- [How to Use AI to Write Google Ads That Lower Your Cost-Per-Click](https://skillsuniversity.org/blog/ai-google-ads-lower-cpc.html): Raising ad relevance with AI to reduce CPC.
- [AI Email Marketing for Small Business](https://skillsuniversity.org/blog/ai-email-marketing-small-business.html): AI drafting, subject line testing, and the three essential automated sequences.
- [How to Use AI for Customer Retention and Repeat Sales](https://skillsuniversity.org/blog/ai-customer-retention-repeat-sales.html): Spotting at-risk customers and automating personal follow-ups.
